utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oren, Quinn said she’ll add me and make sure you get the signup details too. If you like, I can ask her to connect with you directly so you have it written down.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thank you, Uli—that would help me a great deal. If Quinn can send it straight to me, I’ll pin it somewhere before my mind wanders off again.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Of course, Oren. I’ll let Quinn know to send it straight to you, and you can pin it up before the day gets noisy.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hi Rosa, the drive is this weekend from 10 to noon. Priorities are Mrs. Park’s gutter and the loose porch rail, but I still need confirmed tools, batteries, and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo—just to keep everyone aligned, it’s Sunday at the community center from 10 to noon. I’ll mark Mrs. Park’s gutter and the loose porch rail as top priorities, and I’ll keep chasing confirmations on tools, batteries, and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa. Please add Oren as confirmed to help on the day, and send me any supply confirmations as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Faye, I’m still pulling the pieces together—so far it’s small household items, bikes, appliances, plus a couple urgent fixes like Mrs. Park’s porch rail and gutter. I’m waiting on the exact kickoff time and signup details before I start assigning folks.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo—that helps. I’m planning on 10 to noon between school runs, so once Mara confirms the kickoff and signups, I can help with setup and pointing folks toward the urgent fixes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks Faye—I’ll pencil you in for setup and triage from 10 to noon, and I’ll confirm once Mara’s kickoff and signup details land.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Cleo, I’m still waiting on the exact kickoff time, but I’m getting my tool chest, bike stand, tire kit, and spare fasteners ready. If you hear what storage or sign-up help Pia needs, send it my way and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus — I’ll mark your tool chest, bike stand, tire kit, and spare fasteners as expected for now. I’ll also send along anything I hear about Pia’s storage or sign-up needs, and I’m still keeping batteries on the needed list.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, Cleo—thanks for keeping track. I’ll add a battery tester and a few common spares to my pile, just in case.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Mara, I’ve got Saturday 10 to noon written down, with you and Faye coordinating. I’ll keep the repair list tidy and point folks toward the right tools as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Eli—that’s exactly what we need. I’ll keep sending you the repairable-item categories and tool volunteers as they come in so the list stays clean for Saturday 10 to noon.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Mara—send them in batches if you can, and I’ll sort them by item type and tool need. That way Saturday morning stays orderly.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Pia, I’ve got the basics: the community center’s repair drive is for small household items, bikes, and appliances, but I’m still waiting on Gus to confirm the kickoff time. So far Gus has tools and fasteners covered, and Cleo still needs batteries noted as a gap.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess—until Gus confirms the kickoff time, let’s mark it as tentative and avoid printing flyers. Can you also flag batteries clearly on the list and make sure small items, bikes, and appliances each have separate drop-off labels?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Pia—I’ll keep the kickoff marked tentative, hold off on flyers, and make sure batteries are flagged clearly. I’ll also tell Cleo to split the drop-off labels for small items, bikes, and appliances.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Opal, I’ve got the details now: the repair drive is Saturday from 10 to noon, with Faye and Mara coordinating. I’ll keep you on the invite list and point you to Eli if you’ve got any tool or repair questions.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn—I’ve noted Saturday 10 to noon, with Faye and Mara coordinating. Could you send me the exact location too, and I’ll add Eli as the tool-question contact.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Opal—I’ll send you the exact location as soon as I have it, and yes, Eli’s the right person for tool or repair questions.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hi Hana — I may be a little behind, but last I heard Faye can help from just before 10 through noon, Cleo’s checking supplies, and we still need to pin down the urgent repair list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — I’ve got Faye tentatively for just before 10 to noon and Cleo on supplies, but I’ll confirm both before assigning; so far Leo flagged Mrs. Park’s porch rail and leaking gutter as the urgent repairs.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Hana — porch rail and leaking gutter for Mrs. Park sounds like the clearest priority I’ve heard so far. I’ll pass that along, but I’ll tell folks you’re still confirming Faye and Cleo before we lock anything in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Sam, I’m trying to keep the repair drive details straight — have you and Cleo or Kira settled on a location yet?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Not yet, Rey—I’m still waiting on the final location and schedule details, but I’ll let you know as soon as they’re confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Sam — I’ll hold off on telling people anything firm, then. When you hear, could you tell me once clearly so I can pass it to Oren and help him write it down?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Dane, we’re still lining up the repair drive details—Jules is gathering tools, spare parts, and volunteer time, Uli’s checking the notice board, and I’m waiting on Eli for the schedule and drop-off info.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — I’m late to the thread, but I’ll ask my block today who has basic tools, screws, tape, batteries, or a couple hours, then send Jules names and what they can bring.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, thanks Dane—send Jules the names and supplies, and if anyone mentions a repair request, pass that my way so I can keep Uli and Ira in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules—I’m still making the rounds, so I’ll send any solid leads on tools, supplies, or spare hands straight to you as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks Ira—just send names and what they can offer, and I’ll plug them into the right spot without overloading anyone.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do, Jules—I’ll keep it to clear names and offers, and I’ll check any details before sending them your way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Mina, I just heard through Faye that Mara’s repair drive is 10 to noon, and Eli will have the list sorted there. I still only have small appliances and bikes second-hand, so I’ll check once more before telling you what tools to bring.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Nell—10 to noon is useful, but I still need the confirmed priority list before I line up tools. Please check with Mara or Eli directly and tell me whether small appliances or bikes come first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I will, Mina—I’ll try Mara or Eli directly now and come back to you today with which comes first, instead of guessing from Faye’s note.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Kira, I’m trying to connect the different groups without overpromising—do you know anyone who can bring tools, spare parts, or help keep signups and repair labels organized?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Maybe, Jules—but before I ask people, can you confirm who’s officially coordinating this, and whether the date, time, and meeting spot are set yet?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Good question, Kira—I’m helping connect people, but I don’t want to claim more than that until I confirm the official lead and the exact date, time, and spot. I’ll check with the core folks first, then circle back so you can ask people with solid details.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Pia, I’m starting to gather names for tools and table space, and Gus said he can help spot gaps once I have a short list. Do we know the setup location yet, or is that still being settled?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, Rosa confirmed it’s Sunday at the community center, with the community room as the main drop-off. Could you send her your tool and table-space list as you gather it, and flag anything Gus thinks we’re short on?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, I can do that. I’ll send Rosa the list as it comes together and note any gaps after Gus has a look.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Bo, I’m checking who can lend screws, tape, batteries, basic tools, or a bit of time for the repair drive—can I put you down for anything?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Sam, I’m mostly coordinating the list right now, but put me down for tape and some basic tools if needed. Batteries are still the big gap I’ve heard about.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Bo — I’ll mark you for tape and basic tools, and I’ll keep chasing batteries since that sounds like the biggest missing piece.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Cleo — I’m still piecing it together, but Faye told me Mara’s coordinating the repair drive from 10 to noon, with Eli helping sort the repair list. I’d still double-check with Mara before spreading tool details.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Nell — I’ll mark the time and Eli’s role as tentative until I confirm with Mara, and I won’t list any tool details yet.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds safest, Cleo. I’ll keep asking around too, and if I hear anything directly from Mara or Eli I’ll pass it along as confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Oren, I’m glad I caught you—Saturday’s repair drive is 10 to noon, with Faye and Mara coordinating, and I can get you the signup details right away.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh Quinn, thank you—that’s exactly the thread I kept dropping. Could you send me the signup details, and remind me where I should show up Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Oren—I’ll send you the signup details now. Plan to show up Saturday from 10 to noon where Faye and Mara are coordinating, and I’ll point you to them when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Faye, I’m keeping the repair drive list current—can you tell me what you’re bringing and exactly where you plan to drop it off?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Opal, I’ll be there a little before 10 and can bring labels, markers, and a clipboard for the repair list. I’ll drop them at Mara’s setup table and stay until noon before school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, Faye—I’ve logged labels, markers, and a clipboard at Mara’s setup table before 10, with you staying until noon.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Noah, I’m catching up late, but I can help pin down the tools list and match it to whatever repair items folks have already signed up for.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: That’d be great, Dane — I’m a little behind, but Cleo’s checking what supplies are actually in the community room, and I think the urgent repair list still needs pinning down.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good—once Cleo confirms what’s already there, I’ll compare it with the urgent repair list and note the tool gaps. I’ll also ask my block what they can lend so we’re not guessing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Vik — I haven’t forgotten. I’ll check the notice board this afternoon and send you the exact sign-up details so you can pass them along cleanly.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Uli—I’ll wait for your note and then pass the exact details along to Jules and Ira so nobody’s working off rumors.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That helps, Vik. I’ll keep it quiet and exact, and you’ll have the board details from me after I’ve checked them.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Ira, I’m setting aside my bike stand, tire kit, and small-appliance tools, and I can bring bins or a folding table too if Pia still needs help keeping the sign-ups and storage orderly.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds really useful, Gus—I’ll pass along to Jules that you’ve got bike and small-appliance tools plus bins or a table, and I’ll ask whether Pia still needs setup help once the time and spot are pinned down.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Ira—tell Jules and Pia I’m flexible, and once they’ve got the time and spot, I can come early to help set up and keep the tool area tidy.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Mara. For now mark tools as still needed, and I’ll check with Cleo and Quinn before the 10-to-noon slot.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Leo—I’ll mark tools as still needed and add that you’re checking with Cleo and Quinn before 10 to noon. Porch rail and Mrs. Park’s gutter stay at the top of the list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. I’ll report back once Cleo or Quinn confirms any tools, especially a ladder and gutter supplies.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Hi Tess, the repair drive is Saturday from 10 to noon, with Faye and Mara coordinating. I’m keeping the tool and repair-needs list, so if you’ve got batteries, tape, screws, or basic tools to offer, I’ll mark them down.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, thanks Eli—I’ll pass along Saturday 10 to noon and that Faye and Mara are coordinating. I’ve heard Gus has a tool chest and spare fasteners, and batteries are still a gap, so I’ll send folks your way with anything else.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s helpful, Tess—I'll note Gus for the tool chest and fasteners, and mark batteries as the main gap. Please have anyone with batteries or tape check in with me before Saturday so the list stays clear.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Mina, quick repair drive update: it’s now Sunday at the community center, and the community room is our main drop-off. If you hear what folks are bringing or who can help, send it my way so I can keep the list tidy.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Rosa—do you have the start time and the urgent repair list yet, or are we still waiting on Nell and Hana? I won’t match tools or helpers until that’s nailed down.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’re still waiting on the exact start time and the urgent repair list—Bo’s needs list hasn’t come through yet, and I’ll check whether Nell or Hana has it. Hold off on matching for now, and I’ll send you the confirmed details as soon as I have them.
